rules.title: NVIDIA display container rewrites its log file without pause
rules.summary: A plugin of the NVIDIA display container service rewrites one log file continuously. Reports reach tens of gigabytes per hour. Not every machine on an affected driver shows it.
rules.fix_note: 621.35 is a hotfix driver based on 621.24, for Windows 10 and 11.
rules.delivery_note: The fix is a hotfix driver. NVIDIA publishes hotfix drivers as a separate download from its support site and folds them into the next regular driver; no report shows the NVIDIA app or Windows Update offering this one. It has to be downloaded and installed by hand.

workaround.note: Stops the container from loading the plugin that writes the log. NVIDIA does not document this value. It was seen to stop the writes on one affected machine.

rules.title: AMD External Events Utility writes dump files while idle
rules.summary: The AMD External Events Utility service writes rotating dump files into an EeuDumps folder while the machine is idle and when windows are moved or resized.
rules.fix_note: 26.11.1 is reported to fix the writes on Radeon RX 7000 series and newer; 26.11.2 is reported to extend the fix to RX 5000 and RX 6000. Nothing is stated for older or integrated adapters, so a newer version number alone does not prove the fix there.
rules.delivery_note: The fix first appeared in a release AMD lists as Optional, while an older release stayed the Recommended one. An installation that follows recommended releases only, or a driver that came from Windows Update or the system maker, does not receive it on its own.

workaround.note: Disables the service. Reported to break FreeSync and hotkeys when the AMD adapter drives a display, so it is offered only when it drives none.
